verdict.rationale: Vast.ai publishes the source of its official CLI and SDK in the public GitHub repo vast-ai/vast-cli, so some first-party client code is readable. Nothing in the evidence names a license for that repo, and the marketplace platform itself is not shown to be open source. missing for 10: an evidenced open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache) on the repo, source availability for the core platform/console/serverless backend, independent corroboration of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Provides both the CLI and SDK for managing Vast.ai GPU cloud resources, plus a serverless client for endpoint inference.
